Card Q&A.a: No. This effect can’t ignore digivolution requirements. When activating this effect, you can only digivolve into a card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits if it also meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: If I have cards in my trash with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in their traits, does this card's [End of Attack] effect let me digivolve any card into them, regardless of digivolution requirements?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 purple level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost.
[End of Attack][Once Per Turn] You may digivolve 1 of your other Digimon into a Digimon card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits from your trash without paying its memory cost.
